credits.title: A Bowl of Chicken Noodles Before I Die
credits.overview: If today were your last day, what one small thing would you really want to do?  For Ale, the answer is simple: enjoy a bowl of his favorite chicken noodles before he truly gives up on life. But when his regular food cart is closed, that situation leads him into a series of unexpected encounters.

credits.title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
credits.overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

credits.title: Ghost in the Cell
credits.overview: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

credits.title: Rainbow on Mars
credits.overview: Pelangi is an Indonesian child born on Mars. Together with her robot friends, she embarks on a great journey that will determine the future of Earth. Can they overcome it?

credits.title: Crocodile Tears
credits.overview: An overbearing mother who lives with her son in a secluded crocodile farm spirals out of control when her son sees the outside world and falls for a girl for the first time.

credits.title: Janur Ireng
credits.overview: After losing their family home in a devastating fire, two impoverished siblings accept the hospitality of a wealthy long-lost uncle, unaware that his grand estate holds a sinister plot to exploit them.

credits.title: sMOTHERed
credits.overview: After surviving a severe accident with lingering amnesia, a micro-painting artist begins to suspect that the woman who visits claiming to be his mother is actually a dangerous stranger.

credits.title: The Elixir
credits.overview: An elixir unleashes the undead in a village. A family at odds with one another must unite and fight to survive as their hometown collapses.

credits.title: Cursed
credits.overview: Because of Rini's spell, Edi left his wife and two children. As a daughter who lost her father, Vita tried to win back her father's love and bring him back into the arms of his family.

credits.title: Guna Guna Istri Muda
credits.overview: Horror pierces Vivian's life when her husband, Burhan, decides to marry Angel, an avaricious young woman who uses witchcraft to terrorize her family.

credits.title: A Date with the Death
credits.overview: Rudi, a freelance graphic designer, is too absorbed in his career and dies suddenly from exhaustion. When his spirit is reaped by Death, Rudi refuses to sign the documents that consent his departure from this world.

credits.title: Kang Mak from Pee Mak
credits.overview: Returning home with his friends, a soldier reunites with his wife, not knowing she's become a ghost. But her death's not the end of their love story.

credits.title: Glenn Fredly: The Movie
credits.overview: Starting from the determination and great desire to create a music concert to embrace peace in Ambon City, Glenn ultimately gave up all his income to hold the concert.

credits.title: Deadly Love Poem
credits.overview: Words of poetry spell certain death when a young woman grows increasingly distraught after a string of unusual murders take place.

credits.title: Stealing Raden Saleh
credits.overview: To get his father out of prison, a master forger assembles a diverse team of specialists to steal a priceless painting.

credits.title: Kamu Tidak Sendiri
credits.overview: An ambitious career woman is taking an elevator to her office in a hurry and in the elevator there is one of her coworkers and they are both trapped in the elevator and have to wait until the elevator technician comes.

credits.title: Cemara's Family 2
credits.overview: Set in the post-pandemic period, the Cemara Family begins a new chapter in their lives. Abah gets a new job, Euis grows up to be a teenager, and Mom focuses on taking care of the youngest, Agil. While everyone was focused on their respective activities, Ara felt left out. How can this family get through this new phase

credits.title: Dear Imamku
credits.overview: Haris and Alysa, lovers who are also YouTubers, are successful by selling their romantic relationship content. Life suddenly changes when Haris almost loses his mother to a stroke. Haris decided to move and cut his relationship with Alysa. How is the continuation of Haris's intention to move?

credits.title: World Agent
credits.overview: Citra & Reza wanna get married, but stonewalled by their parents who believe in the story of Bubat War, where Javanese can't possibly marry Sundanese.

credits.title: Yang Tak Tergantikan
credits.overview: Aryati, a divorcee, works as an online taxi driver to support her three children, Bayu, Tika, and Kinanti. Together, they confront the hardships of family life.

credits.title: Sejuta Sayang Untuknya
credits.overview: This is a loving and playful drama that inspires and brings light to a father’s love of his only child. He struggles to provide for his only daughter.

credits.title: Bidadari Mencari Sayap
credits.overview: Reza and Angela are trapped in differences in beliefs and culture. Reza is Moslem and of Arab descent married Angela is Chinese descent.

credits.title: Glorious Days
credits.overview: Because of an incident when they were in high school, members of the Bebas Gang were forced to separate. 23 years later, one of them is seriously ill and hopes to meet again one last time.
